stemMd:
Because the early survey covered only accessible valleys, the historian cautioned against treating its results as ______ of the entire region, which also included remote upland settlements.

Which choice best completes the text?
explanationMd: The sample omits upland settlements, so its findings may not stand for the whole region. Representative expresses that relationship between a sample and its target population.

distractorRationale.c: The results can be understood while still being unrepresentative.
distractorRationale.d: The issue is coverage, not damage caused by the survey.
distractorRationale.b: The concern is not whether one survey depended on another.
